chunks: And it was narrated: “He discontinues the talbiyah when he looks upon al-Masjid al-Haram.”

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the talbiyah recited in ihram during pilgrimage rites

ai.seo_question: When should the talbiyah be stopped during ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the muhrim performing ʿumrah ends the talbiyah upon seeing al-Masjid al-Haram. It is a concise fiqh ruling related to the rites and limits of talbiyah during pilgrimage.
